text.name: Alakazam

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

text.name: Blastoise

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 {Water} Energy card to 1 of your {Water} Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {Water} Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

text.flavor: Shellfish Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 189 lbs. A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

text.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Scrunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Chansey does 80 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Egg Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 76 lbs. A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

text.name: Charizard

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into {Fire} Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.

text.flavor: Flame Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 200 lbs. Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

text.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding Energy cards. (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Clefairy's type is still Colorless.)

text.flavor: Fairy Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 17 lbs. Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

text.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Atrocious Pokémon. Length: 21' 4", Weight: 518 lbs. Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

text.name: Hitmonchan
text.flavor: Punching Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 111 lbs. While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

text.name: Machamp

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Strikes Back
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's attack damages Machamp (even if Machamp is Knocked Out), this power does 10 damage to the attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power can't be used if Machamp is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.

text.flavor: Superpower Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 287 lbs. Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

text.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 80 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Magnet Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 132 lbs. Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

text.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Barrier
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Psychic} Energy card attached to Mewtwo in order to use this attack. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mewtwo.

text.flavor: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

text.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Nidoking does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

text.flavor: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

text.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Lure
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Ninetales in order to use this attack.

text.flavor: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

text.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Poliwrath but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {Water} Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

text.flavor: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

text.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Raichu.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Raichu does 30 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

text.name: Venusaur

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Energy Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 {Grass} Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

text.flavor: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

text.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos in order to use this attack.

text.flavor: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

text.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Poison Bee Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 65 lbs. Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

text.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

text.flavor: Dragon Pokémon. Length: 13' 1", Weight: 36 lbs. A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

text.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Mole Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 73 lbs. A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

text.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Thunderpunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Electabuzz does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Electric Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 66 lbs. Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

text.name: Electrode

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Buzzap
abilities.text: At any time during your turn (before your attack), you may Knock Out Electrode and attach it to 1 of your other Pokémon. If you do, choose a type of Energy. Electrode is now an Energy card (instead of a Pokémon) that provides 2 energy of that type. This power can't be used if Electrode is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Electric Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Electrode does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Ball Pokémon. Length: 3' 11", Weight: 147 lbs. It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

text.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Bird Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 66 lbs. Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

text.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Arcanine in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Arcanine does 30 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Legendary Pokémon. Length: 6' 3", Weight: 342 lbs. A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

text.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Charmeleon in order to use this attack.

text.flavor: Flame Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 42 lbs. When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

text.name: Dewgong

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Sea Lion Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 265 lbs. Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

text.name: Dratini
text.flavor: Dragon Pokémon. Length: 5' 11", Weight: 7 lbs. Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

text.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Leek Slap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Farfetch'd stays in play (even putting Farfetch'd on the Bench won't let you use it again).

text.flavor: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

text.name: Growlithe
text.flavor: Puppy Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 42 lbs. Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

text.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dream Eater
attacks.text: You can't use this attack unless the Defending Pokémon is Asleep.

text.flavor: Gas Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 0.2 lbs. Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

text.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Seed Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 29 lbs. When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

text.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Meditate
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Human Shape Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 90 lbs. Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

text.name: Kadabra

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Psychic} Energy card attached to Kadabra in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Kadabra.

text.flavor: Psi Pokémon. Length: 4' 3", Weight: 125 lbs. It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

text.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Kakuna during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Cocoon Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 22 lbs. Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

text.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 50 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Machoke.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: Machoke does 20 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Superpower Pokémon. Length: 4' 11", Weight: 155 lbs. Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

text.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Magikarp.

text.flavor: Fish Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 22 lbs. In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

text.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Magmar in order to use this attack.

text.flavor: Spitfire Pokémon. Length: 4' 3", Weight: 98 lbs. Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

text.name: Nidorino

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Poison Pin Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 43 lbs. An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

text.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Tadpole Pokémon. Length: 3' 4", Weight: 44 lbs. Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

text.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Conversion 1
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless.

attacks.name: Conversion 2
attacks.text: Change Porygon's Resistance to a type of your choice other than Colorless.

text.flavor: Virtual Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 80 lbs. A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

text.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Super Fang
attacks.text: Does damage to the Defending Pokémon equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).

text.flavor: Rat Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 41 lbs. It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

text.name: Seel
text.flavor: Sea Lion Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 198 lbs. The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

text.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Wartortle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Turtle Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 50 lbs. Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

text.name: Abra

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Psi Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 43 lbs. Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

text.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Bulbasaur.

text.flavor: Seed Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 15 lbs. A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

text.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Worm Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 6 lbs. Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls. LV. 13 #10

text.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Charmander in order to use this attack.

text.flavor: Lizard Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 19 lbs. Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

text.name: Diglett
text.flavor: Mole Pokémon. Length: 0' 8", Weight: 2 lbs. Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

text.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Twin Bird Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 86 lbs. A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

text.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Hypnosis Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 71 lbs. Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

text.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Sleeping Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Destiny Bond
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Psychic} Energy card attached to Gastly in order to use this attack. If a Pokémon Knocks Out Gastly during your opponent's next turn, Knock Out that Pokémon.

text.flavor: Gas Pokémon. Length: 4' 3", Weight: 0.2 lbs. Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

text.name: Koffing

attacks.name: Foul Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned; if tails, it is now Confused.

text.flavor: Poison Gas Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 2 lbs. Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

text.name: Machop
text.flavor: Superpower Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 43 lbs. Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

text.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magnemite does 40 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Magnet Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 13 lbs. Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

text.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Metapod during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Cocoon Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 22 lbs. It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

text.name: Nidoran ♂

attacks.name: Horn Hazard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Poison Pin Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 15 lbs. Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

text.name: Onix

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Onix (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Rock Snake Pokémon. Length: 28' 10", Weight: 463 lbs. As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

text.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Tiny Bird Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 4 lbs. A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Mouse Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 13 lbs. When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

text.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Poliwag but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {Water} Energy after the 2nd don't count.

text.flavor: Tadpole Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 27 lbs. Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

text.name: Ponyta
text.flavor: Fire Horse Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 66 lbs. Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

text.name: Rattata
text.flavor: Rat Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 8 lbs. Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

text.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Mouse Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 26 lbs. Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

text.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Tiny Turtle Pokémon. Length: 1' 8", Weight: 20 lbs. After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

text.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Water} Energy card attached to Starmie in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Starmie.

attacks.name: Star Freeze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Mysterious Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 176 lbs. Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

text.name: Staryu
text.flavor: Starshape Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 76 lbs. An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

text.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Vine Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 77 lbs. Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

text.name: Voltorb
text.flavor: Ball Pokémon. Length: 1' 8", Weight: 23 lbs. Usually found near power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

text.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Fox Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 22 lbs. At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

text.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Hairy Bug Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 7 lbs. Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

text.name: Clefairy Doll
effect: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Clefairy Doll has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Clefairy Doll is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Clefairy Doll.

text.name: Computer Search
effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Devolution Spray
effect: Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).

text.name: Imposter Professor Oak
effect: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

text.name: Item Finder
effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

text.name: Lass
effect: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

text.name: Pokémon Breeder
effect: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

text.name: Pokémon Trader
effect: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Scoop Up
effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

text.name: Super Energy Removal
effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

text.name: Defender
effect: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Energy Retrieval
effect: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

text.name: Full Heal
effect: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

text.name: Maintenance
effect: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

text.name: PlusPower
effect: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

text.name: Pokémon Center
effect: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

text.name: Pokémon Flute
effect: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

text.name: Pokédex
effect: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

text.name: Professor Oak
effect: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

text.name: Revive
effect: Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

text.name: Super Potion
effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

text.name: Bill
effect: Draw 2 cards.

text.name: Energy Removal
effect: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

text.name: Gust of Wind
effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

text.name: Potion
effect: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

text.name: Switch
effect: Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

text.name: Double Colorless Energy
effect: Provides {Colorless}{Colorless} energy.
Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.
